newsitem.title: DUBAI: PLO's Arafat meets Saudi King Fahd in Jeddah.
newsitem.headline: PLO's Arafat meets Saudi King Fahd in Jeddah.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat met Saudi Arabia's King Fahd on Tuesday and presented the monarch with a medal of honour for his service to the Palestinian people, Saudi television said.

Arafat, who arrived in the eastern Saudi port city of Jeddah on Tuesday on the first leg of a Gulf tour, also met with other officials, the state-run television said, but did not give details of the talks.
Palestinian officials had said Arafat hoped to discuss deadlocked PLO-Israeli peacemaking with officials in Saudi Arabia and other Gulf states.

Arafat began his trip as Israeli troops shot and wounded dozens of Palestinians in the West Bank town of Hebron. Four consecutive days of violence reflect a further crack in the stalled Middle East peace process.
Arafat last visited Saudi Arabia in December.
Saudi-PLO relations, which soured during the 1991 Gulf War due to the PLO's support for Iraqi President Saddam Hussein, have improved since the 1993 PLO-Israeli peace deal.
Saudi Arabia pledged $100 million as part of the international donor states' support for development of the Palestinian economy, so far delivering around $30 million. 1133 170697 GMT
